page.overview:
What is Ancient Citizens?

The Ancient Citizens, also known as Titans, were a mysterious alien race discovered on Lethe, deep underground in Xeno City.

Little is known about the mysterious Ancients. They're supposedly grown from the city walls and are one living organism with the biomechanical city. Based on the skeletal remains found in the city, the Ancients were humanoid in appearance, and massive in size, with encrusted bodies, elongated heads, and two thin arms. They lacked fully developed jaws and legs and had large pelvis bones. Many tubes were fusing into their bodies with one tube running across their chests and into their jawless mouths.

The actual origin, history, and role of these creatures is unknown. Thought just a speculation, at some point in history long before the human settlement on Lethe, the Ancients either bred the Xenomorphs for specific purposes, or their moon fell victim to a rival species. Whatever the case may be, the Xeno City succumbed to the infestation of Xenomorphs who adapted to their morphology.

One of the Citizens of the Xeno City was subdued by a large facehugger variant, impregnated with a chestburster and was killed when the creature erupted from its chest. It's unknown what events unfolded following Titan's birth, all other Citizens of the Xeno City died out while the Titan Xenomorph scrapped its den and remained dormant.
